title: Authenticate the European signed world delta table and constructor boundaries
platforms: EUR source and retained Wine evidence
changes: Reconcile all four constructor defaults and both neighboring source roots against e337-d336. Identify the complete 48-entry signed table and its original literal and index guard.
validation: Protected source census kk_mzy8p verifies the EUR ROM, all spans, direct load instructions and seven previously validated Wine inventories. The three 28-byte peers have no proved producer. The interior address-shaped word lies in PCM and has zero matching literal loads. The signed table and its literal account for 52 unowned bytes.
limitations: The seven retained inventories have no overlaps. The new table still needs file-backed runtime and ordinary-use proof. Constructor peer producers, Linux and USA remain open. No performance measurements.
